narr: Monsoon moisture slowly seeped into the region under the big dome of high pressure which was causing record-breaking temperatures, fueling isolated to scattered thunderstorms. As the moisture increased, the main thunderstorm impact transitioned from high winds to flash flooding.
ev: Mountain View Road was closed between Crystal Drive and Desert Greens Drive.
Hackberry Road was closed from Main Street to Highway 66 due to flooding from runoff from storms which occurred hours earlier.
Antares Road was closed from Highway 66 to Pierce Ferry Road due to flooding from runoff from storms which occurred hours earlier.
Flooding and debris covered Pierce Ferry Road from Highway 93 to mile marker 4.
Flooding and debris covered several roads in the Hualapai Mountains.
